WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY 1
)
SELECT
  to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_label,
  gross_revenue,
  gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS increase
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY increase DESC NULLS LAST

       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status = 'Returned')::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'), 0) AS return_rate,

GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled') >= 100
ORDER BY return_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH jan_users AS (
    SELECT id, created_at
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id AS user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM jan_users u
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY u.id, u.created_at, oi.order_id
    HAVING MIN(oi.created_at) >= u.created_at 
       AND MIN(oi.created_at) < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
),
user_order_counts AS (
    SELECT ju.id AS user_id, COUNT(uo.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM jan_users ju
    LEFT JOIN user_orders uo ON uo.user_id = ju.id
    GROUP BY ju.id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count >= 2)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)),
        4
    ) AS share
FROM user_order_counts

SELECT 
  u.traffic_source,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS user_count,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id 
  AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY u.traffic_source
ORDER BY gross_revenue_per_user DESC

SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS median_hours
FROM public.order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete'
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
    ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS total_net_revenue
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH user_first_orders AS (
    SELECT u.id AS user_id
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook'
      AND u.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        uo.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN user_first_orders uo ON uo.user_id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY uo.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_date) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_date END) AS first_order_date,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_date END) AS second_order_date
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
),
day_diffs AS (
    SELECT 
        (second_order_date::date - first_order_date::date) AS days_diff
    FROM first_two
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff) AS median_days
FROM day_diffs

WITH user_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id,
    TO_CHAR(u.created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi 
      WHERE oi.user_id = u.id 
        AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
        AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at 
        AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ordered_within_30
  FROM public.users u
  WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT acquisition_month, 
       ROUND((SUM(ordered_within_30)::double precision / COUNT(*))::numeric, 6) AS share
FROM user_activity
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH fb_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users 
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN fb_users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_rank
  FROM user_orders
),
second_third AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 3 THEN order_time END) AS third_order_time
  FROM ranked_orders
  WHERE order_rank IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 3 THEN order_time END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM (third_order_time - second_order_time))) AS median_days
FROM second_third

WITH user_spend AS (

  FROM public.order_items

SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend)::numeric, 2) AS p90_gross_spend
FROM user_spend

WITH organic_users AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Organic'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN organic_users u ON u.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_rank
    FROM user_orders
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT
        r1.user_id,
        r1.order_time::date AS first_order_date,
        r2.order_time::date AS second_order_date,
        (r2.order_time::date - r1.order_time::date) AS days_between
    FROM ranked_orders r1
    JOIN ranked_orders r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id AND r1.order_rank = 1 AND r2.order_rank = 2
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between))::numeric, 0) AS median_days_between_first_and_second_order
FROM first_second

WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    user_id,
    MIN(created_at) AS order_time,
    SUM(sale_price) AS order_value
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
),
user_first_order AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(order_time) AS first_order_time
  FROM order_values
  GROUP BY user_id
),
order_classification AS (
  SELECT 
    ov.order_id,
    ov.user_id,
    ov.order_value,
    CASE 
      WHEN ov.order_time = ufo.first_order_time THEN 'first'
      ELSE 'repeat'
    END AS order_type
  FROM order_values ov
  JOIN user_first_order ufo ON ufo.user_id = ov.user_id
),
medians AS (
  SELECT 
    order_type,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_order_value
  FROM order_classification
  GROUP BY order_type
)
SELECT 
  ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN order_type = 'first' THEN median_order_value END) - 
         MAX(CASE WHEN order_type = 'repeat' THEN median_order_value END))::numeric, 2) AS diff_first_minus_repeat
FROM medians

WITH non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        MIN(created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
      AND status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY user_id, order_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS seq
    FROM non_cancelled_orders
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN seq = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_time,
        MAX(CASE WHEN seq = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_time
    FROM ranked
    WHERE seq IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN seq = 2 THEN order_time END) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM second_time - first_time)) AS p95_days
FROM first_second

WITH search_users AS (
    SELECT id 
    FROM public.users 
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Search' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,

    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders

first_second AS (

        r1.order_time AS first_order_time,
